implementation_policy: MuJoCo 3.3.7 CPU solve (physics/native.py) of an unpowered 150 g wooden toy train between two guided steel compression springs (wire 1.1 mm, mean coil 24 mm, 12 active turns, rest length 120 mm, E = 200 GPa; left spring preloaded by 45 mm) with finite-mass pusher plates: the grooves reduce the chassis to longitudinal translation, six revolute wheels exchange bounded maximum-dissipation Coulomb traction impulses with the track, rolling torque acts at the hinges, the plates touch the train unilaterally; dt = 1/38400 s, 4 s, frame k = native state at (k-1)/24 s. Wheel geometry comes from the registered assets/scenes/thomas_dual_spring_train/canonical/geometry.json. Edits change only their DSL field (train mass x3, rolling resistance x4, right spring modulus x0.25, right spring and plate removed, an 85 g wooden block added on the track). appearance/render.py (Blender 5.1, Cycles OptiX) replays the native states with the overlay of the published videos (appearance/realism.py); the render lifts the solver frame by 0.569 m onto the table. --stage verify checks the accepted delivery (renders/thomas_dual_spring_train). Contact, bearing and material parameters are not calibrated on the toy.
